senses.gloss: to cut into, prick.—Part. pass. חָדוּק, fem. חֲדוּקָה, pl. חֲדוּקוֹת.
units: <cite ref="Chullin 59b">Ḥull. 59ᵇ</cite> <he>ח׳ בעינן</he> Ar. the horns must be prickly (rough); ed. <he>חרוקות</he>, v. <cite ref="H01760"><he>חָרַק</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Eruvin 101a:10">Erub. 101ᵃ</cite> (play on <he>חדק</he>, <cite ref="Micah 7:4">Mic. VII, 4</cite>, a. <he>והדקות</he>, <cite ref="Micah 4:13">ib. IV, 13</cite>) <he>שמְחַדְּקִין אוה״ע וכ׳</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>שמְהַ׳ את הרשעים</he>) those who force the nations into Gehenna; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 556:1">Yalk. Mic. 556</cite>. Y. Sabb. X, end, 12ᵈ <he>להַדֵּיק בה וכ׳</he> to close with it (to stuff it into) defective bags.

senses.gloss: to be driven into, to stick to. Tanḥ. Ki Thissa 1; Pesik. R. s. 10, beg. (ref. to Prov. XV, 19) as the thorn מִתְחַדֶּקֶת בבגדיו וכ׳ sticks to the garments &c.
